item.title: Issue #2984 created
item.description:
Serialization parameters everywhere (and sometimes wrong)

When doing #2981, I noticed inconsistencies in the presentation of the serialization parameters. For example, allow-duplicate-names is missing from the XSLT table, and the omit-xml-declaration defaults vary (yes/impl-defined/no).

I think we should refactor the spec in this regard and summarize the serialization parameters in one place. I will make an attempt.
